title: Parañaque Titans unveil roster for Maharlika Pilipinas Pickleball Tour
summary: Leander Paez Lazaro and Sarah Jane Restauro Lim headline the Parañaque Titans' ten-athlete roster that will see action in the inaugural season of the Maharlika Pilipinas Pickleball Tour (MPPT).
